topics.title: Fart Story at Madison Square Garden
topics.summary: During a visit to MSG, friend Stokes recounts an embarrassing incident involving a loud fart in a men's room stall. A man named Gary jokingly claims he can identify any tune from one note, leading to awkward small talk with Bon Jovi keyboardist David Bryan and a brief encounter with Dr. Ruth.

topics.title: Stern Confronts Dr. Ruth and Lee Majors
topics.summary: Howard Stern aggressively interrogates Dr. Ruth about the impact of stress on sexuality while questioning her recent trip to Israel, then criticizes Lee Majors' sedentary lifestyle and marital troubles with his former playmate, sparking a debate about aging and appearances.

topics.title: Model Affair and Giant Owner Mania
topics.summary: A former model reveals an affair with Christie McNichol and subsequently marries another man. The conversation shifts to Bob Tish, the Giants owner, who is viewed as a hero by callers like Sean Linden due to his wealth and influence; discussions about potential investments in the team conclude awkwardly.

topics.title: Tish Discusses Wealth & Guests
topics.summary: Mr. Tish describes his possessions, including a fifty-four hundred square foot Westchester apartment and multiple properties, contrasting this with the perceived lack of wealth among others like Howard. He expresses frustration over Richard’s behavior during an interview while discussing potential guests such as Leonard and exploring the complexities of relationships within his social circle.

topics.title: Richard's Radio Rant
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, host Richard repeatedly berates co-host Mark for interrupting his show by inserting ABC News feeds and making inappropriate comments. The conversation escalates into personal attacks regarding Mark’s appearance and past television appearances, culminating in an absurd suggestion of a comedy sketch.

topics.title: Howard’s Personal Disclosure
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Howard discusses his evening with Richard and his girlfriend Kim. He reveals he invited Richard to join him and Kim for an outing but was upset when Richard cried over the situation; later, he questions Richard about his relationship with Kim, probing her age and weight before discussing personal details regarding his own life.”} 19 years old.
